decision_rule.authenticated_quality_failure: close this predeclared static causal-gate attempt without opening confirmation
decision_rule.authenticated_quality_pass: freeze a separately sealed package-native confirmation
decision_rule.evidence_failure: stop and diagnose without semantic attribution

limitations: This is a reused six-record development screen, not an unseen holdout.

A pass still requires a separately sealed package-native confirmation.
Logical bytes are analytical native reads, not hardware DRAM counters.
W128 is full context only for this 128-position experiment.
